items.summary: Fix the monthly BTC liquidity detection so the expected lower untouched liquidity zone around ~$27k–$25k is consistently emitted by the reversal-structure (two consecutive opposite candles → wick-based range) logic and appears in the computed liquidity model as a lower LiquidityBox with state='untouched' until first touch.

Fix the liquidity box lifecycle so untouched liquidity boxes (touchCount===0) are never removed, suppressed, or silently not plotted for any reason other than explicit touched+cleared invalidation rules (i.e., no time-based cleanup, distance filters, trend-bias suppression, or structural replacement may hide untouched boxes).

Ensure the chart rendering path deterministically maps each LiquidityBox to x-axis coordinates using candleIndex (not timestamps) and does not drop valid boxes due to start-index lookup failures; if candleIndex is out of bounds, clamp it and still render the box from the nearest valid candle to the latest candle.

Add a small, deterministic developer regression fixture for liquidity detection (a minimal hard-coded candle sequence) that reproduces the missing-lower-zone scenario and verifies: (1) a lower box is emitted, (2) it remains present when untouched, and (3) it only disappears after touched+cleared rules are met.
